detail: Retrospective cohort, 316 prostatectomy patients, one row per patient; single institution, no grouping factor observations repeat within. Time-to-recurrence/logistic outcome with fixed covariates only.

Observational SARS-CoV-2 testing log, 15524 tests at one hospital; the help describes no statistical model and names no response. clinic_name (88 wards) and subject_id are present grouping-capable columns but no documented random-effects model. RULE GAP: a general-package object with repeated columns but no documented model or response.
Retrospective cohort, 64 transplant patients, one row per patient; single institution, no grouping factor, fixed-covariate logistic/survival outcome.

Aggregated case-control table of esophageal cancer (ncases/ncontrols by age/alcohol/tobacco strata); a fixed-effects binomial GLM over ordered covariates, no grouping factor. Also the medicaldata re-export of base R esoph.
Single-center RCT of video vs standard laryngoscope, 99 patients, one row per patient; Randomization is a fixed treatment, no grouping factor (repeated attempts are wide columns).
Single-center RCT, 235 patients, one row per patient; treat is a fixed treatment and the repeated cough/pain outcomes are wide columns, no grouping column.

Single-site RCT of sulindac in familial adenomatous polyposis, 22 participants, one row per participant; polyp counts at baseline/3m/12m are wide columns, no grouping factor (classic HSAUR Poisson/negbin GLM).
Lind's 1757 scurvy trial, 12 seamen, one row per seaman, 6 fixed treatments; no grouping factor observations repeat within.
Transit-time comparison of 8 critically ill patients vs 87 volunteers, one row per subject; Group is a 2-level fixed comparison, no random grouping factor.
1948 streptomycin TB trial, 107 patients, one row per patient; arm is a fixed treatment, no center or other grouping column in the table.
Single-center RCT of nerve-block anesthetic mixtures, 103 patients, one row per subject; group is a fixed treatment, no grouping factor.
One-way design, insect counts under 6 sprays; spray is the fixed treatment of interest, no blocking or grouping factor.
One-way design, dried plant weight under 3 conditions; group is the fixed treatment, no grouping factor (textbook one-way ANOVA).
Michaelis-Menten enzyme kinetics (rate vs conc); the only factor, state (treated/untreated), is a 2-level fixed treatment comparison, no random grouping factor with replication.
Monthly UK road-casualty time series, 192 months, one row per month; a single multivariate time series with no grouping factor/replication.
Guinea-pig tooth length by supplement and dose (2x3 factorial), one measurement per animal; supp and dose are fixed factors, no grouping factor or animal id.
One row per US state of crime-rate and urbanization variables; a cross-sectional PCA/clustering example, no grouping factor or documented grouped model.

Daily New York air-quality measurements, one row per day; the documented use is cross-sectional regression (Ozone ~ Solar.R + Wind + Temp), Month/Day are temporal indices and no grouping model is documented.
Anscombe's quartet, 4 constructed x/y pairs in 11 rows to illustrate regression; no grouping factor and no real grouped data.
One row per department of aggregated clerical-survey ratings; a cross-sectional regression example, no grouping factor.
Body-temperature time series of a single beaver, one row per timepoint; one time series with no grouping/replication.
Body-temperature time series of a single beaver (with an activity indicator), one row per timepoint; one time series with no grouping/replication.
50 cars, speed vs stopping distance, one row each; a bivariate regression example with no grouping factor.
One-way design, chick weight under 6 feed supplements; feed is the fixed treatment, no grouping or blocking factor.
2x2-way contingency table (finger length by body height) loaded as a counts matrix; an aggregate cross-tabulation with no grouping factor.
Aggregated esophageal-cancer case-control table (ncases/ncontrols by age/alcohol/tobacco); a fixed-effects binomial GLM over ordered covariates, no grouping factor.
Old Faithful eruption/waiting times, 272 eruptions, one row each; a bivariate/density example with no grouping factor.
150 flowers of 3 species; a classification/discriminant example where Species is the response/target, not a documented random-effects grouping factor.
32 cars, one row each, automobile performance variables; a cross-sectional regression example with no grouping factor.
8x8 contingency table of father vs son occupational status loaded as a counts matrix; an aggregate association-model table, no grouping factor.
Curated/simplified version of penguins_raw (same 344 individuals, cleaned subset of columns); a derived table of another object of this source.
Palmer penguins raw measurements, one row per individual; species/island are small fixed/classification factors, no documented random-effects grouping model.
1000 Fiji earthquakes, one row per event (location, depth, magnitude, stations); a spatial regression example with no grouping factor observations repeat within.
48 rock samples, one row each, petroleum permeability variables; a regression example with no grouping factor.
The 21x3 predictor matrix of stackloss (Air.Flow, Water.Temp, Acid.Conc.) with no response column; a derived submatrix of another object of this source.
Stack-loss plant data, 21 observations, one row each; a multiple-regression example with no grouping factor.
One row per US state of socioeconomic indicators loaded as a matrix; a cross-sectional regression example, no grouping factor.
47 Swiss provinces, one row each, fertility and socioeconomic indicators; a cross-sectional regression example with no grouping factor.
31 black cherry trees, one row each (girth, height, volume); a regression example with no grouping factor.
Topographic elevation grid of Maunga Whau (87x61 matrix) loaded as rows of elevations; coordinates only, no grouping factor or response.
Warp breaks by wool type and tension (factorial), one row per loom but no loom id column; wool and tension are fixed factors, no grouping column (documented lm(breaks ~ wool*tension)).
